messages.subject: Online course - Geometric Morphometrics
parts:
Dear all,

 

registrations are now open for the next edition of the  Geometric Morphometrics course on April 8-12, 2024, designed for international participants and held online for your convenience.


Instructor: Dr. Carmelo Fruciano (University of Catania, Italy).

 

In this course, we will explore the standard practices in modern geometric morphometrics, covering data acquisition, analysis, visualization, and interpretation of results. It is a five-day program featuring lectures and hands-on sessions, focusing on 2D data and user-friendly software. Participants will also gain insights into 3D data and R implementations. Ideal for beginners and intermediate users seeking a structured background in geometric morphometrics.

 

Course website: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/course22/

 

For the full list of our courses and workshops, please have a look at: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/

 

 

Best regards,

Carlo

 

 

--------------------

Carlo Pecoraro, Ph.D
